summary: the largest time step for which a particle's root mean squared displacement in one step stays a stated fraction of the smallest size

inputs.name: fraction
inputs.meaning: the largest root mean squared displacement in one step, as a fraction of the size

inputs.name: size
inputs.meaning: the smallest size in the system, the smallest particle's diameter for one

inputs.name: diffusivity
inputs.meaning: the largest diffusivity in the system, that of the smallest particle for one

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.meaning: how many dimensions the particles move in

outputs.name: time_step_max
outputs.meaning: (fraction x size)^2 over 2 x dimensions x diffusivity

validity: a stochastic integration of diffusion, Brownian or Langevin, whose accuracy is set by the displacement per step; it is not the stability limit of a grid

source.locus: Derivation for n dimensions: MSD = 2nDt, n the number of dimensions

note: No value of the source stands behind the worked cases: each is worked by hand in its worked field. The fraction is a margin and an input with its own source, never this skill's.
